blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A 20-year-old man was arrested early Friday morning, November 6, 2026, after allegedly scaling a residential fence and entering a home in Barangay Lahug, Cebu City, reportedly in need of money for his jeepney fare. Authorities identified the suspect as Carl, single, unemployed, and a resident of Sitio Fatima, Barangay Apas, Cebu City. Initial police reports said the incident occurred at around 2:40 a.m. at Golden Valley Homes in Laguerta, Barangay Lahug.
